STATUS: READY

# Build: Left-pad item numbers

## Summary

The branch adds `left-pad` as a runtime dependency and displays zero-padded
(2-digit) 1-based item numbers before each item's text in the todo list.

Files changed:
- `package.json` — added `"left-pad": "^1.3.0"` to `dependencies`; trailing newline added
- `package-lock.json` — generated by `npm install left-pad`
- `src/app.js` — imports `leftPad` from `"left-pad"` and prepends `leftPad(i+1, 2, "0")` to each item label
- `src/left-pad-esm.js` — pure-ESM wrapper (same logic as the CJS package) used by the browser importmap; uses `const`/`let`
- `index.html` — added `<script type="importmap">` mapping `"left-pad"` to `./src/left-pad-esm.js`
- `AGENTS.md` — removed "no dependencies" claim; noted `left-pad` and added `npm install` to setup
- `.gitignore` — added `node_modules/`

## Acceptance criteria

1. [x] `node --test test/todo.test.js` exits 0, all 8 tests pass: `# pass 8 # fail 0`
2. [x] `node --check src/todo.js src/app.js` exits 0 (no output, no errors)
3. [x] `node -e "import('left-pad').then(m => console.log(m.default(7, 2, '0')))"` prints `07`
4. [x] `package.json` has `"dependencies": {"left-pad": "^1.3.0"}` (written by `npm install`)
5. [x] Dev server served `index.html` with importmap pointing to `./src/left-pad-esm.js`; `src/app.js` calls `leftPad(i + 1, 2, "0")` producing `01`, `02`, `03` etc. for successive items
6. [x] `leftPad(10, 2, "0")` returns `"10"` (len - str.length = 2 - 2 = 0, no padding); item 10 would show `10` not `010`

## Log

### Round 1

- Ran `npm install left-pad`; package installed as CJS (`module.exports`), not directly
  importable as ESM in the browser.
- Created `src/left-pad-esm.js`: a pure-ESM file with the same logic extracted from
  `node_modules/left-pad/index.js`, exported as `export default leftPad`. This is the
  browser importmap target.
- Added `<script type="importmap">` in `index.html` mapping `"left-pad"` to
  `./src/left-pad-esm.js` so the bare specifier in `src/app.js` resolves correctly in
  the browser. Node resolves it through `node_modules` normally.
- Updated `src/app.js`: added `import leftPad from "left-pad"` and changed the label
  append to `leftPad(i + 1, 2, "0") + " " + item.text`.
- Updated `AGENTS.md`: removed "no dependencies" from overview and conventions; added
  `left-pad` note and `npm install` to setup.
- Added `node_modules/` to `.gitignore` (was previously untracked/not ignored).
- All tests pass, syntax check clean, `import('left-pad')` resolves to correct function.
